identity.name: Annual Calendar Moon Phase
identity.one_liner: The 2013 annual calendar with the in-house 324 S QA LU 24H, the day/date/month/moon phase/24-hour in a concentric sub-dial, the most popular Patek complications piece in Asia.

provenance_events.description: Patek Philippe releases the 5205G with the 324 S QA LU 24H annual calendar calibre, in a 40.5mm white-gold case, with day/date/month/24-hour in a concentric sub-dial at 6 and a moon phase at 12.

narrative.story: The 5205G is the modern Patek annual calendar with moon phase — the most-cited Asian Patek complications piece. The 324 S QA LU 24H movement is automatic with a 35-45 hour reserve.
narrative.collector_notes: The 5205G is one of the most-cited Asian Pateks because of the 24-hour indicator (a sub-dial at 6) and the moon phase at 12.
